Jamie Park: Thanks for joining the all-hands. Quick follow-up thread for clarifications and owners. Please ack and add ETAs.

Omar S: Ack. I'll take the Dedicated capacity heatmap update. Will post a PR with numbers by Thu.

Rina V: I'll own the Private deployment customer checklist (KMS, network, export controls). Drafting checklist now and will tag Legal.

legal-bot: Note: Existing NDA template covers typical EU deployments but special industries may need addenda. Recommend legal review per-customer.

Omar S: Question: do we want public-facing latency targets or only in contracts?

Jamie Park: Short answer: both. Public "targets" for marketing (high level) and contract SLA terms in enterprise docs. Rina - include public wording examples in checklist.

Rina V: Will do. Also flagging a doc gap: rollout runbook lacks canary criteria. Who owns that?

Jamie Park: Ben Ortega (infra) volunteered during the AH; tagging him to that runbook. Ben, please add canary pass/fail thresholds.

eng-bot: Recording and slides uploaded: https://drive.redwood.com/all-hands/may-2026  (recording: https://redwood.zoom.us/rec/share/ijkl9012)

Omar S: Filing CAP-3309 for heatmap. ETA: Thu EOD.

Rina V: Draft checklist up, tagging legal for export/KMS questions. ETA: Monday noon.

Jamie Park: Action recap: Omar  Dedicated heatmap CAP-3309; Rina  Private checklist + public SLA wording; Ben  canary criteria in rollout runbook. Please add estimated hours in your tickets by EOD Monday. Reply with :white_check_mark: when done.

Omar S: Ack :white_check_mark:

Rina V: Ack :white_check_mark:

Jamie Park: Thanks everyone — closing this in 48h unless new asks appear.
